subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable shape should replace full inline `systemPromptReport` persistence in `sessions.json` while preserving bootstrap warning dedupe?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally persist the full report for warning-signature state, and repository policy discourages adding parallel JSON sidecars or config knobs without a clear owner decision.

options.title: Compact report state
options.body: Persist only the load-bearing warning dedupe fields and any small summary needed by status/diagnostics, then drop the bulky tools/skills/system prompt details from session entries.

options.title: Move report diagnostics
options.body: Move bulky report diagnostics into a canonical SQLite-backed or diagnostics-owned store and keep only a reference or small summary in the session entry.

options.title: Preserve current behavior
options.body: Accept the full inline report for now and treat this issue as blocked until the broader session metadata storage direction is scheduled.

recommendation.title: Compact report state
recommendation.body: Persist only the load-bearing warning dedupe fields and any small summary needed by status/diagnostics, then drop the bulky tools/skills/system prompt details from session entries.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent central owner for the prompt-blob mitigation and session metadata changes that frame the remaining storage policy choice.
